plan.title: The Hidden Wisdom
plan.beats: The boat belonged to poor people and a king seized every sound ship; the boy and his believing parents; the wall hid a treasure of two orphans whose father was righteous; I did not do it of my own accord. End the Musa series and tease the next prophet: Yusuf.

plan.title: The Dream
plan.beats: Eleven stars, the sun and the moon prostrating; his father Yaqub tells him not to tell his brothers.

plan.title: The Well
plan.beats: The brothers' jealousy; the plan; thrown into the well; the shirt with false blood; Yaqub says beautiful patience.

plan.title: Sold in Egypt
plan.beats: Travelers draw water and find him; sold for a few dirhams; the Egyptian who bought him tells his wife to honor him.

plan.title: The Test
plan.beats: Keep modest and non-sensual: the woman of the house tries to seduce him, he seeks refuge in Allah; the torn shirt from behind proves his innocence.

plan.title: Prison
plan.beats: He prefers prison; two prisoners' dreams; he calls them to tawhid first; interprets the dreams.

plan.title: The King's Dream
plan.beats: Seven fat cows eaten by seven lean, seven green ears and seven dry; Yusuf explains the years of plenty and famine.

plan.title: Over the Treasures
plan.beats: He insists his innocence be cleared first; the women confess; he is placed over the storehouses of the land.

plan.title: The Brothers Return
plan.beats: The brothers come for grain and do not recognize him; Binyamin; the king's cup in the bag.

plan.title: The Reunion
plan.beats: Yaqub's grief and hope; I am Yusuf; no blame on you today; the shirt cast over his father's face restores his sight; the dream comes true.

plan.title: Nine Hundred and Fifty Years
plan.beats: His long call night and day; they put fingers in their ears.

plan.title: The Ark
plan.beats: Build the ark under Our eyes; they mock; the oven gushes; pairs of every kind; his son refuses; the flood; it rests on Al-Judi.

ideas.title: The Man Allah Spoke To
ideas.beats: Jabir is grieving after Uhud: his father Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Haram is martyred, leaving debts and daughters. The Prophet ﷺ tells him: Allah speaks to no one except from behind a veil, but He spoke to your father directly: ask Me. He asked to return and be killed for Allah again. Allah said it is decreed they will not return. Then 3:169 was revealed.
ideas.trend_signal: @ilmora.io reel on this story, 76K views, 77x their median (Nov 2026)

ideas.title: The Palm Trunk That Cried
ideas.beats: The Prophet ﷺ gave sermons leaning on a palm trunk; a pulpit was made; the trunk cried out; he came down and placed his hand on it until it calmed.
ideas.trend_signal: Several Hindi/English shorts on the crying palm trunk in the last 30 days

ideas.title: A Thousand Fed at the Trench
ideas.beats: Digging the Trench, hunger; Jabir sees the Prophet ﷺ with a stone tied to his stomach; prepares a small goat and a little barley; the Prophet ﷺ invites the whole army; about a thousand eat their fill and the pot is still full.
ideas.trend_signal: 'Feeding 1,000 with one kilo of barley' short trending in the niche

ideas.title: The Queen Who Asked for a House in Paradise
sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 3411 (Asiya named among the perfect women)
ideas.beats: Pharaoh's wife takes in the baby from the river (28:9, already seen in Part 1); she believes; she prays: My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds (66:11). The Prophet ﷺ named her, Asiya, among the women who reached perfection (Bukhari 3411). Shown only through a palace window, a lamp and a house of light; no person drawn.
ideas.trend_signal: @airsultaan reel on Firaun and Asiyah, 352K views, 9.3x median (Nov 2026)
ideas.fact_note: Name Asiya from Bukhari 3411, not from the Qur'an; say so in narration.

ideas.title: The Day Fatimah Stood Up for Her Father
ideas.beats: At the Ka'bah, the Prophet ﷺ is in prostration; Abu Jahl's group has camel entrails placed on his back and laughs; he stays in sujood; young Fatimah comes, removes it and rebukes them; he finishes his prayer and supplicates against them. Keep non-graphic; show only the Ka'bah, the light in prostration and a small lamp for Fatimah.
ideas.trend_signal: 'Fatimah defends her father' shorts in the sahaba/seerah niche, Nov 2026
